post.summary: Signs in with a Google ID token.
post.description: Exchanges a verified Google ID token for this API's own JWT, which carries the user's role, permissions and scope. Sign-in is invitation-only: the e-mail must have been pre-registered by an admin (POST /api/users), which is what determines the role the first login already carries; only a configured bootstrap admin provisions itself. Failure modes worth handling apart: 401 when the Google token is invalid or its e-mail is unverified; 403 when the e-mail is not registered, or the account exists but is deactivated; 429 when the rate limit trips; and 501 when Google sign-in is not configured in this environment. The error_code tells the two 403s apart — auth.user_not_registered against auth.user_inactive.

Creating a user as Admin when the e-mail is unknown is deliberate for local setup, and is exactly why the environment gate matters. Rate-limited like the real sign-in.

post.summary: Registers a payment against an installment.
post.description: Settles part or all of one installment. Payments are APPEND-ONLY: once a payable has one, it can no longer be edited or cancelled, and undoing a payment means reversing it rather than deleting it. Amount is the principal and cannot exceed the outstanding balance; interest, fine and discount are recorded separately and do not count toward it. Partial payments are fine — the installment settles when the balance reaches zero.

Undoes a payment by recording a reversal — the payment row itself stays, because the trail is append-only. The installment balance goes back up and the payable returns to its pre-payment state. Accounting is rebooked accordingly. Reversing an already-reversed payment returns 409.

post.summary: Matches a bank transaction to an installment.

Breaks the link between a statement line and its installment - the line goes back to unmatched. What happens to the payment depends on who created it. When the match registered the payment itself, it is reversed here; the reversal is recorded rather than erased, since payments are append-only. When the match merely LINKED a payment that already existed (paymentPreexisting = true, e.g. a baixa applied by the CNAB return), the line is only unlinked and the payment is left untouched - reversing it would undo money the bank actually moved.

Builds the CNAB file the bank executes, in one of two modes: send InstallmentIds to remit exactly what the operator picked, or send only DueCutoff to sweep every eligible installment due up to that date. Sending both is not a merge - the selection wins and the cutoff is ignored. The included installments are locked into the remittance, so they stop appearing as payable until the bank returns. Nothing is settled yet: payment only happens when the return file confirms it.

get.description: Every seeded role with the permissions currently granted to it. Roles are seeded, not created through the API — there is no create or delete here, only editing which permissions a role carries.

put.description: Sets the role's complete permission set — a permission left out of the list is revoked. This affects every user holding the role, and since permissions are baked into the JWT at sign-in, the change reaches them on their next login rather than immediately.

get.description: The static catalogue of permissions in `resource:action` form. It is compiled into the API, not stored, so it is the authoritative set of values accepted by PUT /api/roles/{id}/permissions — the access-admin screen builds its checkboxes from it.

get.summary: Lists users with role, status and scope.
get.description: Every user with their role, active flag and full scope — companies, units and cost centers. Feeds the access-admin screen. A reference list: no paging and no filters. A user pre-registered but who has never signed in is flagged pendingFirstLogin.

post.description: Creates the user before their first sign-in, already carrying the role, the scope and the approval authority they should have — so the first Google login lands on the intended access instead of a default one. Until that login the row is listed with pendingFirstLogin = true. Registering is the authorization: the e-mail may sign in even if its domain is not on the AllowedDomains list. An e-mail already registered returns 409 (user.email_already_registered); an unknown role or a malformed e-mail returns 400.

put.description: Sets the highest value the user may approve (alçada). It is a hard cap read live by the budget-adjustment flow, with no override — an adjustment above the limit is refused rather than escalated — so a change here takes effect immediately. Null means unlimited.

Assigns one of the seeded roles by name. Permissions and scope are denormalized into the JWT at sign-in, so the new role takes effect on the user's NEXT login — an open session keeps the old permissions until its token expires.

Sets the whole scope at once — companies, units and cost centers — by diff against what the user has. The lists are explicit and fail-closed: an empty one grants nothing rather than everything, and anything left out is revoked. A unit or cost center whose company is not also granted returns 400. Only scoped roles (Requester, Approver) are constrained by it; for the others it is stored and ignored. Timing differs by role: the Requester's scope travels in the JWT, so it applies on next login, while the Approver's is read live and applies immediately.

Deactivating blocks sign-in: both Google sign-in and the dev token refuse to issue a token for the account. It does NOT revoke a token already issued — an open session keeps working until that token expires, so this is not an immediate lockout.

A second gate on top of the role permission: Controladoria carries budget-adjustments:approve, but only users flagged here may actually approve or reverse an adjustment. Read live at approval time, so revoking it takes effect immediately rather than on next login. Admin and Presidency bypass the flag.

baseAmount.description: Calculation base attributed to this company, in BRL.

withheldAmount.description: Withheld under this company's CNPJ, in BRL.

CompanyAssessmentRowResponse.description: One company's slice of the assessment. This is a fiscal dimension — the CNPJ here is the one that collects, so this breakdown is what the XML export is built from.

active.description: Whether the company is in use. An inactive company is kept for history but drops out of the selector and of every list that offers a company to pick.

CompanyResponse.description: A company (mantenedora / unidade jurídica) — the root of the org chart. Everything else in the system hangs off one.

payableId.description: Payable the installment belongs to, so the screen can link straight to it.

counterpartyName.description: Vendor on the payable — the name an operator recognises.

documentNumber.description: Document number of the payable, when it has one.

sequence.description: Which installment of the payable this is, 1-based.

installmentCount.description: How many installments the payable has in total.

remaining.description: Outstanding balance of the installment — net of withholdings and of anything already paid. This, not the gross amount, is what a bank debit has to match.

amountDelta.description: Absolute gap between the statement amount and the outstanding balance. Zero on an exact match; anything else is juros, desconto or a partial payment.

dayDelta.description: Absolute gap in days between the statement date and the due date.

ConciliationCandidateResponse.description: An open installment near enough to a statement line to be worth showing next to it — either the suggestion the matcher made, or a near miss that explains why it made none. The two deltas say how far it sits from the line, so an operator can judge the pairing without opening the título.

payableId.description: Payable the payment settled, so the screen can link straight to it.

counterpartyName.description: Vendor on the payable — the name an operator recognises.
counterpartyName.example: AR SMARTVIX SERVICOS DE CERTIFICACAO DIGITAL LTDA

documentNumber.description: Document number of the payable, when it has one.

sequence.description: Which installment of the payable was settled, 1-based.

installmentCount.description: How many installments the payable has in total.

dueDate.description: Due date of the settled installment — the date to compare against the statement day.

amount.description: Amount of the payment that settled it.

paymentDate.description: Date the payment was registered under (the bank's effective date on a CNAB baixa).

notes.description: Free-text note the settling flow wrote — e.g. "CNAB retorno" or "Conciliação: …".

ConciliationMatchedTitleResponse.description: The payable side of a reconciled statement line, for showing the pairing.

code.description: Accounting code of the cost center.

name.description: Cost center name, denormalized so the row renders without a second call.

withheldAmount.description: Withheld on payables charged to this cost center, in BRL. There is no base here on purpose — the base is a fiscal figure and this view is not.

CostCenterAssessmentRowResponse.description: One cost center's slice. Management analytics only — it is NOT a fiscal dimension and never reaches the XML export, so do not reconcile it against what is collected.

costCenterName.description: Cost center name, denormalized so the row renders without a second call.

orcado.description: The month's ceiling, in BRL. Zero when no budget cell exists — see Budgeted, which distinguishes that from a ceiling deliberately set to zero.

realized.description: Paid in the month, in BRL.

committed.description: Empenhado, in BRL — approved but not yet paid.

forecast.description: Previsto, in BRL — what is in the pipeline but not yet approved, so it does not consume the ceiling yet.

consumed.description: What actually consumes the ceiling, in BRL: Realized plus Committed.

available.description: Ceiling minus Consumed, in BRL. This is what a new requisition is checked against — Forecast is not subtracted.

budgeted.description: Whether a budget cell exists for this month. False means unbudgeted, which is not the same as a ceiling of zero — it is why an Orcado of 0 needs this flag to be read.

CostCenterBudgetLineResponse.description: One cost center's budget position for a single competency. The figures overlap by design — Consumed is Realized plus Committed, so adding all of them double-counts.

realized.description: Total paid against this cost center, in BRL, over all time.

CostCenterRealizedResponse.description: A cost center's total spend across every competency — the figure on the cost-center list card. Not scoped to a month, unlike the budget line.

companyId.description: Company the cost center belongs to.

name.description: Cost center name as it appears throughout the UI.

annualBudget.description: Sum of the cost center's active monthly budget cells, in BRL. Derived on read — there is no stored annual budget, so it changes whenever a cell does.

autoApprovalLimit.description: Ceiling, in BRL, under which a payable charged to this cost center is approved without human review. Zero disables it, sending everything to an approver.

active.description: Whether the cost center is in use. An inactive one is kept for history but is rejected on new requisitions.

unitIds.description: Units this cost center serves. A requisition is only valid on a unit that appears here.

CostCenterResponse.description: A cost center (natureza) with the units it serves. It is what a requisition consumes budget from, and the budget itself lives in the monthly cells, not here.

CostCenterScopeAssignment.description: A granted (company, cost center) pair. Same keying rule as the unit pair.

count.description: How many monthly cells were created.

items.description: The cells themselves, one per month of the range.

CostCenterUnitBudgetPeriodResponse.description: What a period budget creation produced. The period is only a way to create many cells at once — nothing stores it, and each month can be edited on its own afterwards.

costCenterId.description: Cost center that owns the cell.

unitId.description: Unit the budget is earmarked for.

companyId.description: Company both belong to.

monthlyLimit.description: Ceiling for this month, in BRL. Approved requisitions consume it; an adequação raises, lowers or transfers it.

active.description: Whether the cell counts. An inactive cell is ignored by the budget check and by the annual roll-up.

CostCenterUnitBudgetResponse.description: One month of budget for a Unit x Cost Center pair. This is where the money actually is — the cell is what a requisition consumes and what an adequação moves.

companyId.description: Company that owns the account.

bankCode.description: Bank code (codigo de compensacao), three digits.

agency.description: Branch number (agencia), without the check digit.

accountNumber.description: Account number, without the check digit.

accountType.description: Kind of account — checking, savings and so on.

alias.description: Short name shown in the account pickers.

openingBalance.description: Balance the account started with, in BRL. The cash-flow projection anchors on the reconciled balance instead, so this is a starting point, not the live figure.

isDefaultForPayments.description: Use this account when a payable does not name one of its own. Only one per company should carry the flag. The CNAB payment method is NOT set here — it comes from each installment/payable.

cnabAgreementCode.description: CNAB agreement code (convenio) given by the bank. REQUIRED to generate a payment remittance from this account — without it the account can receive and pay manually but cannot produce a CNAB file.

ledgerAccountId.description: Ledger account that represents this bank account — the credit side when a payable is settled. Required on create; left null on update the settlement falls back to the global cash code.

ofxAccountId.description: OFX account identifier (ACCTID). Used to warn when an imported statement actually belongs to another account. Optional.

agencyDigit.description: Branch check digit. Part of the optional CNAB remittance header profile.

addressStreet.description: Paying company street, for the CNAB remittance header. Optional.

addressNumber.description: Paying company street number, for the CNAB remittance header. Optional.

addressComplement.description: Paying company address complement, for the CNAB remittance header. Optional.

addressCity.description: Paying company city, for the CNAB remittance header. Optional.

addressCep.description: Paying company postal code, for the CNAB remittance header. Optional.

addressState.description: Paying company state (UF), for the CNAB remittance header. Optional.

payerCnpj.description: Override the payer CNPJ used in the CNAB file. Empty falls back to the owning company's CNPJ.

payerLegalName.description: Override the payer legal name used in the CNAB file. Empty falls back to the owning company's legal name.

unitId.description: Unit the adjustment belongs to. The company is derived from it.

costCenterId.description: Cost center whose budget ceiling changes.

type.description: What the adjustment does: Supplementation raises the ceiling, Reduction lowers it, Transfer moves budget from SourceCompetency into Competency.

competency.description: Destination accounting competency (`YYYY-MM`) — the month whose ceiling is raised, or lowered for a Reduction.

sourceCompetency.description: Source competency (`YYYY-MM`) the budget comes out of. Required for Transfer, rejected for the other types.

value.description: Amount to move, in BRL. Always positive — the direction comes from Type.

justification.description: Why the adjustment is needed. Required — it is what triage and the approver read.
justification.example: Reallocation of the unspent training budget to cover equipment maintenance.

counterparts.description: Free-text note on where the offsetting budget comes from (contrapartidas).

legalName.description: Legal name (razão social) of the company.

cnpj.description: Company CNPJ. Accepted formatted or bare.

companyId.description: Company the cost center belongs to.

code.description: Accounting code of the cost center. Unique within the company and what the list is ordered by.

name.description: Cost center name (natureza).

autoApprovalLimit.description: Ceiling for automatic approval, in BRL. A payable charged to this cost center whose total is at or below it is approved WITHOUT human review when it gets classified — it does not stop at the approval queue. Zero disables it. This does not apply to requisitions, which are always triaged, complemented and approved.

unitIds.description: Units allowed to charge this cost center. Each one becomes a link, and only a linked unit can be given a monthly budget under it.

name.description: Category name. Must be unique.

companyId.description: Company the entry belongs to. Its accounting period must be open.

competenceDate.description: Accounting competence date — the date that decides which period the entry lands in, not when it was typed.

description.example: Provisão de despesas de manutenção — agosto/2026

sourceReference.description: Free-text pointer back to the originating document, for tracing an entry to what produced it.

lines.description: The entry's lines. Debits must equal credits; an unbalanced entry is rejected.

code.description: Hierarchical account code. Unique across the chart and what the chart is ordered by.

reducedCode.description: Short numeric alias (código reduzido) used for fast entry. Optional, and unique when supplied.

natureza.description: Natureza classification from the chart, 1 to 5. Optional.

name.description: Account name as it appears in the chart and in the reports.

accountGroup.description: Which statement group the account belongs to — it decides where the account surfaces in the balance sheet or income statement.

kind.description: Whether the account receives entries or only groups others. A synthetic (grouping) account cannot be used on a journal line.

parentId.description: Parent account in the chart hierarchy. Omit for a root account.

normalBalance.description: Which side is the account's normal balance. Omit to take the natural balance of its group — override only for the rare account that behaves against its group.

dreLine.description: Which line of the income-statement cascade this account rolls up into. Only meaningful for result accounts; leave null otherwise.

companyId.description: Company that owes the payable.

vendorId.description: Vendor to be paid. Required; must reference an existing vendor (vendors are global to the organization).

costCenterId.description: Cost center the expense is charged to.

unitId.description: Unit (estabelecimento) tag for accounting tracking. Optional; when set it must belong to the same company.

categoryId.description: Expense category. Optional at creation — classification can come later, and is what the accounting posting needs.

origin.description: Where the payable came from. Leave the default for one typed in by hand; the other values are stamped by the flows that generate payables automatically.

documentNumber.description: Number of the vendor's document (nota fiscal, fatura or contract).

issueDate.description: Issue date of the document. It is the accounting competency anchor, so a payable without one has no competency yet and drops out of competency-filtered lists.

installments.description: The installment schedule, authored one by one. Send either this or Generate, not both.

generate.description: Ask the server to build the schedule from a total, a count and a first due date. The alternative to Installments.

accountingAccountId.description: Expense ledger account for the accounting posting. Optional here; it can be set later by classifying the payable.

paymentBankAccountId.description: Bank account the payment will come out of. Omit to use the company's default at payment time.

paymentMethod.description: How this payable is paid. Omit to inherit the paying account's default method — the payment queue filters on that EFFECTIVE method, not on this field alone.

type.description: Service or product. It decides whether source withholdings apply, so it matters fiscally. Only meaningful for a manual payable: once a fiscal document is uploaded, its format (NFS-e or NF-e) sets this authoritatively and overrides whatever was sent here.

unitId.description: Unit the project belongs to. The company is derived from it — a project is never assigned to a company directly.

name.description: Project name. Must be unique within the company.

description.description: Free-text notes about the project's purpose or scope.

budgetLimit.description: Total budget ceiling for the project, in BRL. Cannot be negative.

initialConsumedValue.description: Value already consumed before the project was registered here, in BRL. Use it to carry an opening balance over from a prior system. Cannot be negative.

companyId.description: Company that is owed.

costCenterId.description: Cost center the revenue is credited to.

ledgerAccountId.description: Revenue ledger account for the accounting posting. Optional.

origin.description: Where the receivable came from. Leave the default for one typed in by hand.

documentNumber.description: Number of the document backing the charge.

issueDate.description: Issue date of the document - the accounting competency anchor.

installments.description: The installment schedule, authored one by one. Send either this or Generate.

generate.description: Ask the server to build the schedule from a total, a count and a first due date.

payingBankAccountId.description: Bank account the payments will come out of. It decides which bank layout the file is generated in.

dueCutoff.description: Include every eligible installment due up to this date. IGNORED when InstallmentIds is sent.

installmentIds.description: Exact installments to include. Sending this switches the endpoint to selection mode and the cutoff is ignored. Capped at 500 per remittance.

paymentDate.description: Date the bank should execute the payments. Use it to schedule the batch ahead; it cannot be in the past. Defaults to today.

remittances.description: The remittances generated — one per payment form present in the selection (Pix/Ted/boleto/convênio).

skipped.description: Installments left out, each with its reason.

CreateRemittanceResponse.description: What a remittance generation produced: one file per payment form present in the selection (AEL-933), plus the installments it could not include. A non-empty Skipped list is the normal case, not a failure.

unitId.description: Unit the spend is charged to. The company is derived from it.

costCenterId.description: Cost center (natureza) whose budget the requisition consumes.

type.description: Requisition type. A recurring type (Conta Fixa) is what makes EndCompetency and the payment frequency meaningful.

description.description: What is being requested. Required — it is the headline shown throughout the workflow and the main target of the list's free-text search.
description.example: Preventive maintenance of the lab air conditioning

observation.description: Extra context for triage and the approver.

estimateValue.description: Estimated total, in BRL. Provisional until the financial complement replaces it with the sum of the authored installments.

estimateType.description: How to read EstimateValue: as the total for the whole window, or as the amount per month.

startCompetency.description: First competency the spend lands in (`YYYY-MM`). Required.

endCompetency.description: Last competency of the window (`YYYY-MM`), inclusive. Omit for an open-ended recurrence — it can be closed later through the terminate-recurrence endpoint.

paymentFrequency.description: How often the payment repeats over the window.

paymentInstallmentsCount.description: How many installments the payment is split into.

vendorId.description: Vendor to be paid. Required; must reference an existing vendor (vendors are global to the organization).

firstDueDate.description: Due date of the first installment. Required — it anchors the schedule of the Payable that Finance generates on approval.

projectId.description: Project whose accumulated ceiling this requisition consumes. Optional; the requisition still consumes its cost center's monthly budget either way.

issueDate.description: Optional emission date informed already at creation (front-load). When present with Installments, triage approval sends the requisition straight to the approver.

installments.description: Optional installment plan informed already at creation (front-load). Its sum becomes the requisition's value. Omit to fill it later in the financial-complement step.

companyId.description: Company the transaction belongs to.

unitId.description: Unit the transaction is charged to.

costCenterId.description: Cost center the transaction is charged to.

type.description: Whether this is money going out or coming in — it decides which counterparty field applies.

amount.description: Amount in BRL. Settled in full — this entity has no installments.

unitId.description: Unit the budget belongs to. It must already be linked to the cost center.

endCompetency.description: Last competency of the period (`YYYY-MM`), inclusive. Omit for a 12-month period; pass the same value as StartCompetency for a single month. Capped at 36 months.

monthlyLimit.description: Ceiling for EACH month of the period, in BRL — not the total. Every cell created gets this same value.

active.description: Whether the created cells count toward the budget. Inactive cells are kept but ignored by the ceiling checks and by the annual total.

companyId.description: Company the unit belongs to.

name.description: Unit name.

acronym.description: Short form used wherever the full name does not fit.

code.description: Code carried over from the legacy ERP. Optional, and the stable natural key that lets an import match this unit to its legacy counterpart.

cnpj.description: CNPJ of the establishment, for accounting tracking. Optional; when supplied it is check-digit validated and stored unformatted.

isMatriz.description: Whether this unit is the company's headquarters (matriz).

email.description: The Google account e-mail that will be allowed to sign in. Stored lowercase; must be unique. Registering is itself the authorization — the e-mail signs in even if its domain is not on the AllowedDomains list.

role.description: Role name, which must match one of the seeded roles returned by GET /api/roles. An unknown name returns 400.

name.description: Display name shown until the first sign-in, when Google's own name replaces it.

companyIds.description: Companies the user may access. Same rules as PUT /users/{id}/scope: explicit list, and every scoped unit / cost center must belong to a granted company.

units.description: Units the user may act in, each paired with its company.

costCenters.description: Cost centers the user may act in, each paired with its company.

approvalLimit.description: Approval authority ceiling (alçada) for adequações. Null means unlimited; a negative value returns 400.

canApproveBudgetAdjustment.description: Whether this user may approve and reverse budget adjustments. Only meaningful for Controllership users, who hold budget-adjustments:approve.

companyId.description: Company the customer is registered under.

personType.description: Legal nature of the counterparty. It decides whether Document is read as a CNPJ or a CPF.

name.description: Legal name (razão social) or the person's full name. Required.

tradeName.description: Trading name (nome fantasia), when it differs from the legal name.

document.description: CNPJ or CPF, matching PersonType. Accepted formatted or bare; stored normalized and validated with the check digits.

creditLimit.description: Credit ceiling for this customer, in BRL. Omit for no limit.

companyId.description: Company the customer is registered under. Customers are per-company.

personType.description: Whether the customer is a company (CNPJ) or an individual (CPF).

name.description: Legal name (razão social for a company, full name for an individual).

tradeName.description: Trade name (nome fantasia), when it differs from the legal name.

document.description: CNPJ or CPF, digits only — which one follows PersonType.

phone.description: Contact phone, digits only, with area code.

address.description: Postal address. Comes back with empty fields rather than null when the customer was registered without one.

averageBusinessHours.description: Average business hours from submission to final decision.

payload.description: The PIX copia e cola payload (EMV/BR Code) pasted by the operator.

crcOk.description: Whether the CRC16 check digit matches — a redacted or tampered payload fails this.

isDynamic.description: True for a one-time dynamic QR (payload-location URL → CNAB forma 47).

amount.description: Amount encoded in the QR, in BRL — null for a payer-defined-amount QR.

pixKey.description: The PIX key, for a static QR.

url.description: The payload-location URL (scheme stripped), for a dynamic QR.

email.description: E-mail of the user to sign in as. Lower-cased before lookup. Omitted defaults to dev@ulbra.br. If no user has this e-mail, one is created as Admin.

name.description: Display name used only when this call creates the user. Omitted defaults to Dev User.

companyId.description: Company that employs the person.

document.description: CPF. Accepted formatted or bare; stored normalized and validated with the check digits.

address.description: Postal address. Comes back with empty fields rather than null when the employee was registered without one.

boletoDigitableLine.description: Boleto linha digitável. Only meaningful when PaymentMethod is Boleto.

pixKeyOverride.description: PIX key override for THIS payment (AEL-938). Only meaningful when PaymentMethod is Pix. When set, the CNAB remittance uses it instead of the vendor's registered PIX key; blank uses the vendor's key. The vendor's registered key is never changed.

format.description: What kind of document it is. It decides which of the fields below are meaningful.

accessKey.description: Chave de acesso, 44 digits. XML only.

totalAmount.description: Document total, in BRL, as stated on the invoice. It may differ from the payable's total — nothing forces them equal.

issuerDocument.description: Issuer CNPJ or CPF, digits only.

contentType.description: MIME type of the stored file.

createdAt.description: When the document was registered against the payable.

cfops.description: Distinct CFOPs across the document's items. NF-e only.

ncms.description: Distinct NCMs across the document's items. NF-e only.

icmsAmount.description: ICMS declared on the document, in BRL.

totalTaxesAmount.description: Total taxes declared on the document, in BRL. What the ISSUER declared — unrelated to what we withhold, which the withholding rules compute separately.

ncms.description: Distinct NCMs across the document's items.

icms.description: ICMS total declared on the document, in BRL.

totalTaxes.description: Sum of the taxes declared on the document, in BRL. Unrelated to what WE withhold — those are computed by the withholding rules, not read from here.

normalBalance.description: The side that increases this account — it signs the balances below.

openingBalance.description: Balance carried in from before the range, in BRL. The running balance on the first movement starts from here, not from zero.

movements.description: Movements in the range, in chronological order — the order matters, since each row's accumulated balance depends on the ones before it.

totalDebit.description: Debits in the range, in BRL.

totalCredit.description: Credits in the range, in BRL.

closingBalance.description: Balance at the end of the range, in BRL.

number.description: Sequential number of the entry. Null if it is still a draft.

history.description: The história — what the entry records.

documentRef.description: Reference to the source document, when the entry came from one.

costCenterId.description: Cost center tagged on the line, for management reporting.

debit.description: Debit amount on this row, in BRL. Zero when the row is a credit.

credit.description: Credit amount on this row, in BRL. Zero when the row is a debit.

counterpartyName.description: Counterparty on the source document, denormalized so the ledger reads without opening each entry.

counterpartyDocument.description: Counterparty CNPJ or CPF, digits only.

firstDueDate.description: Due date of the first installment; the rest follow at IntervalMonths spacing.

count.description: Unread count for the current user — what the inbox badge shows.

idToken.description: The Google ID token (JWT) obtained by the browser sign-in flow. It is verified server-side against Google — this endpoint never sees a password.

reason.description: Why the installment is being held. Required — it is what tells whoever works the payment queue why this one is parked.
reason.example: Aguardando nota fiscal corrigida do fornecedor.

dreLine.description: Which line of the DRE cascade this account rolls into.

amount.description: Contribution to the result (credit minus debit), in BRL. Revenues come out positive and costs, expenses and deductions negative — so the cascade adds these rather than subtracting, and a positive expense line means something was posted backwards.

IncomeStatementLineResponse.description: One account's contribution to the result.

companyId.description: Company the report covers. Null means consolidated.

costCenterId.description: Cost center the report was filtered to. Null means unfiltered.

to.description: End of the competence range, inclusive.

sections.description: The cascade, in order. The subtotals below are running sums of these.

revenueDeductions.description: Deductions from revenue — taxes on sales, returns, discounts. Negative, like every other subtraction in the cascade.

netRevenue.description: Receita líquida: gross revenue plus the deductions (which are negative).

costOfSales.description: Cost of goods or services sold. Negative.

grossProfit.description: Lucro bruto: net revenue plus cost of sales.

otherOperatingIncome.description: Other operating income, outside the main revenue line.

operatingExpenses.description: Operating expenses — administrative, commercial, general. Negative.

operatingResult.description: Resultado operacional: gross profit plus other operating income and expenses.

financialRevenue.description: Financial income — interest earned, discounts obtained.

financialExpense.description: Financial expense — interest paid, bank fees, fines. Negative.

financialResult.description: Resultado financeiro: financial income plus financial expense.

otherResult.description: Non-operating result that fits none of the sections above.

preTaxResult.description: Resultado antes dos tributos: operating result plus financial and other results.

netIncome.description: Resultado líquido do período: the bottom line, positive for profit. It is what the balance sheet carries into equity as the period result.

IncomeStatementResponse.description: The DRE for a competence range. Every subtotal is a running sum down the cascade, so they are checkpoints along one calculation and must not be added together.

line.description: Which step of the cascade this section is.

total.description: Sum of the section's lines, in BRL, with the same sign convention.

IncomeStatementSectionResponse.description: One step of the DRE cascade: the accounts that make it up and their combined total.

amount.description: Installment amount in BRL. The payable's total is the sum of its installments.

boletoDigitableLine.description: Boleto linha digitavel, when this installment is paid by boleto.

pixKeyOverride.description: Per-payment PIX key override (AEL-938), when paid by PIX: overrides the vendor's registered key for this payment only. Blank uses the vendor's key.

pixPayloadEmv.description: Per-payment PIX "copia e cola" (EMV/BR Code, AEL-963), when paid by a PIX QR: a static QR decodes to a key, a dynamic QR is sent as its payload URL on the CNAB forma 47 remittance. Mutually exclusive with PixKeyOverride.

sequence.description: Position in the payable's plan, starting at 1.

amount.description: Face value of the installment, in BRL, before withholdings.

status.description: Where the installment stands.

paidAmount.description: Paid so far, in BRL — the sum of non-reversed payments. Partial payment is allowed, so this can sit between zero and NetAmount.

payments.description: Payments made against this installment, oldest first. A reversed payment stays in the list; it just stops counting toward PaidAmount.

netAmount.description: What settles the installment, in BRL: Amount minus its share of the withholdings. This — not Amount — is what a payment is measured against.

scheduledPaymentDate.description: When the treasury intends to pay it. Distinct from DueDate, which is what was agreed with the vendor.

isHeld.description: Whether the installment is held back from the payment queue.

holdReason.description: Why it is held. Present only while IsHeld is true.

paymentMethod.description: How this installment is to be paid, when it differs from the payable's method.

boletoDigitableLine.description: Boleto linha digitável, 47 or 48 digits. Null unless paid by boleto.

pixKeyOverride.description: Per-payment PIX key override (AEL-938). Null unless paid by PIX with an override — when set, the CNAB remittance uses it instead of the vendor's registered PIX key for this payment.

pixPayloadEmv.description: Per-payment PIX "copia e cola" (EMV/BR Code, AEL-963). Null unless paid by a PIX QR — a static QR decodes to a key, a dynamic QR rides the CNAB forma 47 remittance.

rail.description: How the installment can be paid: `Remittance` when it is eligible for a CNAB file, `Manual` otherwise. Computed on read from the paying account, the method and the vendor's bank data — so it changes when any of those do.

manualReason.description: Why the installment cannot be remitted, when Rail is `Manual` — an unsupported bank, a missing agreement code, incomplete payer data. Null when it is eligible. This is the field that explains a disabled checkbox in the payment queue.

remittanceId.description: The remittance this installment travelled in, when it is in one. While that remittance is pending the installment cannot be paid by hand.

remittanceSequence.description: Position of this installment inside that remittance file.

InstallmentResponse.description: One installment of a payable — the unit that actually gets paid. It also carries how it would be paid: by CNAB remittance or by hand, and if by hand, why.

baseAmount.description: Amount the rate was applied to, in BRL. It is not necessarily the payable's total — each tax has its own base rule.

rate.description: Rate applied, as a percentage. Informational: Amount is what is withheld, and it is not recomputed from base times rate.

amount.description: Amount actually withheld, in BRL. This is the authoritative figure — it is what reduces the net payment and what the fiscal assessment reports.

date.description: The competence date these entries share.

totalDebit.description: Debits posted on the day, in BRL.

totalCredit.description: Credits posted on the day, in BRL.

JournalBookDayResponse.description: A single competence day of the Livro Diário, with the day's totals.

number.description: Sequential number, assigned on posting. Null on a draft.

competenceDate.description: Competence date, which is what groups the entry into its day.

description.example: Provisão de despesa — Construtora Horizonte, NF 12345

status.description: Whether the entry is posted or still a draft.

totalDebit.description: Sum of the debit lines, in BRL.

totalCredit.description: Sum of the credit lines, in BRL.

JournalBookEntryResponse.description: One entry as it appears in the Livro Diário, with its lines expanded.

side.description: Whether the line is the debit or the credit.

amount.description: Line amount, in BRL. Always positive — the direction is in Side.

costCenterId.description: Cost center tagged on the line.

JournalBookLineResponse.description: One line of a Livro Diário entry, with the account already resolved to code and name.

companyId.description: Company the book covers. Null means consolidated.

from.description: Start of the range. Null means from the beginning of history.

to.description: End of the range, inclusive. Null means up to the latest entry.

days.description: Days with at least one entry, in chronological order. A day with no movement is omitted rather than returned empty.

totalDebit.description: Debits over the whole range, in BRL.

totalCredit.description: Credits over the whole range, in BRL.

JournalBookResponse.description: The Livro Diário — every entry in the range, grouped by competence day. Read-only: it is a view of the ledger, and nothing is written through it.

companyId.description: Company the entry belongs to.

number.description: Sequential number within the company, assigned on posting. Null while the entry is still a draft — a draft has no number to cite.

competenceDate.description: Competence date, which decides the accounting period the entry lands in. If that period is closed the posting is clamped forward rather than refused.

description.description: What the entry records — the history line the accountant reads.
description.example: Provisão de despesa — Construtora Horizonte, NF 12345

origin.description: What produced the entry: a person posting by hand, or an automatic posting from a payable, a payment or the year-end close.

sourceReference.description: Reference back to what generated the entry, when Origin is automatic — the invoice number of the payable behind it, for example.

status.description: Whether the entry is still a draft or already posted. Only a draft can be edited.

postedAt.description: When the entry was posted. Null while it is a draft.

reversalOfEntryId.description: The entry this one reverses, when it IS a reversal. Present together with the original's ReversedByEntryId — the pair is what shows the correction in the ledger.

reversedByEntryId.description: The reversal that undid this entry, when it HAS been reversed. A reversed entry stays in the ledger with its lines intact; it is the pair that nets to zero.

totalDebit.description: Sum of the debit lines, in BRL. Equal to TotalCredit on any postable entry — they differ only on an unbalanced draft.

totalCredit.description: Sum of the credit lines, in BRL.

lines.description: The lines themselves. At least two, since a single-sided entry cannot balance.

JournalEntryResponse.description: A double-entry journal entry (lançamento) with its lines. Debits and credits must balance before it can be posted, and once posted it is immutable — a mistake is undone by a reversal entry, never by editing.

ledgerAccountId.description: Ledger account this line hits. It must be a posting account — a synthetic (grouping) account cannot receive entries.

side.description: Whether the line debits or credits the account. The entry only posts when total debits equal total credits.

amount.description: Line amount in BRL, always positive — the direction comes from Side.

costCenterId.description: Cost center to charge this line to. Optional, and validated against the entry's company when supplied.

unitId.description: Unit to charge this line to. Optional, and validated against the entry's company when supplied.

description.description: Per-line note. Falls back to the entry's description when omitted.

ledgerAccountId.description: Account posted to. Must be an analytical account.

side.description: Whether this line is the debit or the credit.

amount.description: Line amount, in BRL. Always positive — the direction comes from Side, not from the sign.

costCenterId.description: Cost center the line is charged to, for management reporting. Optional and outside double entry — it does not affect the balance.

unitId.description: Unit the line is charged to. Same as the cost center: analytical only.

description.description: Line-level note, when it adds something the entry description does not.

JournalLineResponse.description: One side of a journal entry — a single debit or credit against one account.

code.description: Hierarchical account code. Its structure is what places the account in the tree, so it is not free-form.

reducedCode.description: Short code used by the legacy ERP and by the accountants day to day. Optional, and unrelated to the hierarchy.

natureza.description: Natureza code carried over from the legacy chart. Kept for reconciliation against legacy reports.

name.description: Account name as it appears in the reports.

accountGroup.description: Which side of the balance sheet or income statement the account belongs to.

normalBalance.description: The side that increases this account. It is what decides whether a balance is shown as positive or negative in the reports.

kind.description: Whether the account takes postings (analítica) or only totals its children (sintética). Posting to a synthetic account is refused.

parentId.description: Parent account in the tree. Null only at the root of a group.

isActive.description: Whether the account may be used. An inactive account keeps its history and still appears in reports covering past periods, but is refused on new entries.

dreLine.description: Which line of the DRE this account rolls into. Null means it does not appear in the income statement — expected for balance-sheet accounts.

LedgerAccountResponse.description: A node of the chart of accounts (plano de contas). The chart is a tree: only leaf accounts take postings, and the synthetic ones above exist to total them up.

token.description: JWT to send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. It carries the role, the permissions and the requester's scope, so anything that changes those only takes effect on the next sign-in.

LoginResponse.description: A successful sign-in: the bearer token plus who it belongs to.

count.description: How many notifications were marked read. Zero means there was nothing unread — the call is idempotent, not failed.

MarkAllNotificationsReadResponse.description: Outcome of marking the inbox read.

installmentId.description: Installment this bank transaction settles. Registering the payment against it is what the match does.

name.description: Display name from the Google profile.

email.description: Google account the user signs in with.

pictureUrl.description: Profile photo from the Google account, refreshed at every sign-in and read live rather than from the token. Null when the account has no photo — fall back to initials, and do the same when the URL fails to load (Google rotates it when the photo changes).

isAdmin.description: Whether the user is an Admin. Admin bypasses every permission and scope check, which is why Permissions and CompanyIds come back empty for one — read this flag first, or an Admin looks like a user with no access at all.

permissions.description: Effective permissions, in `resource:action` form. Empty for an Admin (see IsAdmin) — not because they have none, but because they bypass the check.

companyIds.description: Companies the user may access. Empty for an Admin, who bypasses scope. For a scoped role an empty list means no access, not full access.

canApproveBudgetAdjustment.description: Whether the user may approve budget adjustments. A UI hint only — the server checks this again at approval time, and reads it live rather than from the token.

MeResponse.description: The caller's own profile — identity, role and everything the UI needs to decide what to show. This is what the SPA gates its menu and controls on.

type.description: What the notification is about, as a stable key. It also decides how ReferenceId is shaped.

title.description: Headline, already in pt-BR — notifications are composed server-side rather than translated by the client.

message.example: Sua requisição de manutenção predial foi aprovada e seguiu para pagamento.

referenceId.description: The entity the notification points at, already in its typed-id wire form (`req_…`, `adeq_…`) derived from Type — so the client can deep-link without knowing the mapping. Null when the notification refers to nothing in particular.

occurredAt.description: When the event that produced it happened.

readAt.description: When the user read it. Null means unread — that is what the badge counts.

NotificationResponse.description: One row of the in-app inbox.

items.description: The rows on this page. Empty when the page is past the end — that is not an error, and Total still reports the real size of the set.

pageSize.description: How many rows a page holds. It echoes the requested size after clamping, so it can be smaller than what was asked for.

total.description: How many rows the whole filtered set has, across every page.

totalPages.description: How many pages the set spans at this page size.

NotificationResponsePaginatedResponse.description: One page of a list, with the metadata needed to walk the rest.

description.example: Manutenção preventiva do ar-condicionado do laboratório

stage.description: The stage it is stuck in.

unitId.description: Unit the requisition belongs to.

enteredAt.description: When it entered the stage — the clock's start.

businessHoursElapsed.description: Business hours since it entered the stage.

overdueByHours.description: Business hours past the stage's threshold. Always positive here, since only overdue rows are listed.

estimateValue.description: Value at stake, in BRL — used to sort the queue by what costs most to leave waiting.

OverdueStageResponse.description: A requisition that is overdue in its current stage, right now. Ages are counted in BUSINESS hours, so a weekend does not push a requisition past its SLA.

key.description: Storage key returned by the boleto upload-url request, pointing at the already-uploaded blob.

fileName.description: Original file name, used to detect the media type (PDF or image).

key.description: Storage key returned by the upload-url request, pointing at the blob already uploaded.

fileName.description: Original file name, used to help detect the document format.

ParsedAddress.description: Issuer address read from the document, to pre-fill a new vendor. Every field is nullable because a document may simply not carry it — and there is no complement in the NF-e layout.

digitableLine.description: Digitable line, digits only (47 bancário / 48 convênio). Null when the AI read nothing.

isConvenio.description: True when the line is arrecadação/convênio (starts with 8).

lengthValid.description: True when the line has 47 (bancário) or 48 (convênio) digits — the canonical validation rule.

checkDigitsOk.description: Advisory (non-blocking): the verifier digits (mod-10/11) match. False suggests an OCR-misread digit — the UI asks for review.

dueDate.description: Due date read from the boleto.

issueDate.description: Issue/processing date read, when present on the boleto.

amount.description: Boleto amount, in BRL, when present.

ParsedBoleto.description: What the AI read from a boleto PDF/image, to pre-fill one installment. Nothing is persisted — a preview. The length/convênio/DV flags are computed server-side from the digits. A null line means the AI could not read it and the form opens for manual fill.

format.description: What was parsed: an NF-e XML, an NFS-e XML, or a PDF/image read by the vision extractor. It is what decides which of the fields below can be populated at all.

accessKey.description: Chave de acesso, 44 digits. XML only.

issuerDocument.description: Issuer CNPJ or CPF, digits only — the vendor. It is what the registry match below is keyed on.

recipientDocument.description: Recipient CNPJ, digits only — which of our companies the document was issued against.

rawExtractionJson.description: The extraction as raw JSON, exactly as the parser produced it. Kept so a field the form does not use is still available for auditing what was read.

installments.description: Duplicatas found on the document. Empty when it carries none, which means the operator has to author the plan.

matchedVendorId.description: Vendor matched in the registry by the issuer document. Null means no vendor is registered yet — the form then offers to create one.

matchedVendorName.description: Name of the matched vendor as registered, which may differ from IssuerName on the document.

serviceDescription.description: Service description as written on the document. NFS-e only.
serviceDescription.example: Manutenção preventiva de sistema de climatização

cnaeCode.description: CNAE code stated on the document. NFS-e only.

lc116Subitem.description: LC 116 service subitem. The most reliable of the NFS-e tax signals, and the main input to the withholding rules.

municipalServiceCode.description: Municipal service code. Optional in ABRASF, so it is best-effort.

serviceMunicipalityIbge.description: IBGE code of the municipality where the service was rendered — it decides the ISS rate. Optional in ABRASF, so best-effort.

invoiceIssRate.description: ISS rate stated on the invoice, as a percentage. Best-effort.

issWithheldOnInvoice.description: Whether the invoice itself declares ISS as withheld. Null means the document did not say — which is not the same as false, and the rules treat the two differently.

issuerPhone.description: Issuer phone, to pre-fill a new vendor. NF-e only.

issuerAddress.description: Issuer address, to pre-fill a new vendor. NF-e only.

suggestedType.description: Service or product, inferred by the vision extractor for a PDF or image. Null for XML, where the format already settles it, and null when the model was unsure — so a null here means undetermined, and the operator has to choose.

ParsedFiscalDocument.description: What was read out of a fiscal document, to pre-fill the payable form. NOTHING is persisted by the parse — it is a preview, and every field is a suggestion the operator can override. Which fields come back depends on the format: the NFS-e ones are null for an NF-e and vice versa, so absence means "not applicable here", not "missing from the document".

dueDate.description: Due date as stated on the document.

amount.description: Installment amount as stated, in BRL.

ParsedInstallment.description: One duplicata read from the fiscal document.

status.description: Where the payable stands.

origin.description: How the payable came to exist.

counterpartyName.description: Vendor name as recorded on the payable.

totalWithheld.description: Sum of the withholdings, in BRL — retido.

netTotal.description: What the vendor receives, in BRL — líquido.

accountingAccountId.description: Ledger account applied. Null while pending classification.

accountingAccountCode.description: Code of that account, resolved so the screen does not need a second call.

withholdings.description: The withholdings applied to this payable.

vendor.description: Vendor tax profile. Null when the vendor could not be resolved from the registry.

fiscalDocument.description: The registered Nota Fiscal. Null when none is registered.

hasFiscalDocument.description: Whether a Nota Fiscal is registered — the same fact as FiscalDocument being non-null, kept so a list can check it without pulling the whole document.

PayableAccountingViewResponse.description: Everything the Registro de Despesa screen needs about one payable, assembled in a single call: the money picture, the classification, the retentions, the vendor's tax profile and the Nota Fiscal.

contentType.description: MIME type detected on upload, validated against the file's actual content rather than trusted from the extension.

kind.description: What the file is (Nota Fiscal / Boleto / Fatura / Outro). Only FiscalDocument clears the 'NF pendente' gate.

PayableAttachmentResponse.description: Metadata of a file attached to a payable. The bytes come from the download endpoint.

sequence.description: Position of this installment within the payable, starting at 1.

installmentCount.description: How many installments the payable has in total.

counterpartyName.description: Vendor name as recorded on the payable.

costCenterId.description: Cost center the spend is charged to.

categoryId.description: Expense category, when one was assigned.

amount.description: Face value of the installment, in BRL, before withholdings.

netAmount.description: What actually gets paid, in BRL: the installment net of its share of the payable's withholdings. Equals Amount when there are none.

payableStatus.description: Where the whole payable stands — it can differ from the installment's own status while other installments are still open.

scheduledPaymentDate.description: When the daily sweep will pick this installment up. Defaults to DueDate at creation and can be moved without changing what was agreed with the vendor.

isHeld.description: Whether the installment is paused from the sweep.

holdReason.description: Why it is held. Null when it is not.

remittanceId.description: Remittance the installment is in, if any. While it sits in a pending remittance it cannot be paid by hand.

remittanceSequence.description: Position of this installment inside that remittance file.

rail.description: `Remittance` when the installment can ride the automatic CNAB rail, `Manual` otherwise. Computed live, so it reflects the vendor and account data as they are now.

manualReason.description: Why the rail is Manual. Null when it is not — this is the field that explains a disabled checkbox in the queue.

vendorDocument.description: Vendor CNPJ or CPF, digits only, resolved live from the registry. Null when the vendor no longer exists there.

effectiveMethod.description: The method a remittance would actually use: the payable's own, falling back to the paying account's default. Null means neither is configured, which is itself a reason the installment cannot be remitted.

boletoDigitableLine.description: Boleto linha digitável. Null unless paid by boleto.

documentNumber.description: Invoice number of the payable, when one is registered.

originUnitId.description: Unit attributed to the payable, for accounting tracking.

hasFiscalDocument.description: Whether a Nota Fiscal is registered. FALSE on a scheduled payable is the "NF pendente" condition the treasury screen flags.

PayableListItemResponse.description: One row of the Contas a Pagar list. The grain is the INSTALLMENT, not the payable — a title with three installments produces three rows, each carrying its payable's context.

items.description: The rows on this page. Empty when the page is past the end — that is not an error, and Total still reports the real size of the set.

pageSize.description: How many rows a page holds. It echoes the requested size after clamping, so it can be smaller than what was asked for.

total.description: How many rows the whole filtered set has, across every page.

totalPages.description: How many pages the set spans at this page size.

PayableListItemResponsePaginatedResponse.description: One page of a list, with the metadata needed to walk the rest.

companyId.description: Company that owes.

origin.description: How the payable came to exist: entered by hand, generated from an approved requisition, or created by an integration.

counterpartyName.description: Vendor name as recorded when the payable was created. A snapshot — renaming the vendor later does not rewrite it.

documentNumber.description: Invoice number. Null until a Nota Fiscal is registered, and editable in any state — including after payment.

issueDate.description: Emission date of the invoice. Null until one is registered.

costCenterId.description: Cost center the spend is charged to.

categoryId.description: Expense category, when one was assigned.

totalAmount.description: Document total, in BRL — the invoice's face value, before withholdings.

status.description: Where the payable stands.

rejectionReason.description: Why it was rejected. Present only on a rejected payable.

cancelReason.description: Why it was cancelled. Present only on a cancelled payable.

approvedByName.description: Display name of the approver, resolved for the screen. Null when it could not be resolved — the id above stays the reliable field.

approvedAt.description: When it was approved. An auto-approved payable is stamped here too, so this being set does not mean a human looked at it.

rejectedByName.description: Display name of whoever rejected it.

accountedBy.description: Id of the accountant who reviewed it.

accountedByName.description: Display name of the accountant who reviewed it.

accountedAt.description: When the accounting review was concluded.

accountingAccountId.description: Ledger account the expense was booked to, once the accountant confirmed it.

isClassified.description: Whether the accounting classification is settled. An unclassified payable cannot be paid.

suggestedAccountingAccountId.description: Account the system suggests. A suggestion only — it is not what was booked until the accountant confirms it into AccountingAccountId.

classificationConfidence.description: How confident the classifier is in its suggestion, 0 to 1. Present only when a suggestion exists.

classificationRationale.description: Why the classifier suggested that account, in its own words. Shown to the accountant so the suggestion can be judged rather than trusted.

type.description: Nature of the spend — service or product. It must be determined before the payable can be approved, because the withholdings depend on it.

paymentBankAccountId.description: Bank account the payment goes out of.

paymentMethod.description: How the payable is to be paid. It constrains whether the installments can travel in a CNAB remittance.

installments.description: The installments, in order. This is where the money actually moves.

totalWithheld.description: Sum of the withholdings, in BRL.

netTotal.description: What the vendor actually receives, in BRL: TotalAmount minus TotalWithheld. The withheld part is still owed — to the tax authority instead of the vendor.

originRequisitionId.description: The requisition this payable came from. Null when it was entered directly, which is what tells the two origins apart on screen.

originUnitId.description: Unit (establishment) the payable is attributed to, for accounting tracking. Null when none was attributed.

PayableResponse.description: A payable (título a pagar) with its installments, withholdings and audit trail. The money is owed at this level but paid at the installment level, so a payable is settled only once every installment is.

companyId.description: Owning company, surfaced so the consolidated "Todas as empresas" list can show which one each row belongs to.

counterpartyName.description: Vendor name as recorded on the payable.

costCenterId.description: Cost center the spend is charged to.

categoryId.description: Expense category, when one was assigned.

firstDueDate.description: Earliest due date across the payable's installments — what the list sorts and ages by.

installmentCount.description: How many installments the payable has.

totalAmount.description: Document total, in BRL, before withholdings.

totalWithheld.description: Sum of the withholdings, in BRL. Zero when there are none.

netTotal.description: What the vendor receives, in BRL: TotalAmount minus TotalWithheld. It is only final once accounting completes, since the withholdings lock at Scheduled.

status.description: Where the payable stands.

origin.description: How the payable came to exist.

hasFiscalDocument.description: Whether a Nota Fiscal is registered.

accountingAccountId.description: Ledger account actually applied. Null while the payable is still pending classification.

suggestedAccountingAccountId.description: Account the classifier suggested, kept for human review. Null once the payable is classified — the applied account above is then the one that matters.

classificationConfidence.description: Confidence of the retained suggestion, 0 to 1. Null once classified.

classificationRationale.description: Why the classifier suggested that account. Null once classified.

originRequisitionCode.description: Friendly code of the requisition that generated the payable — what the accounting list displays and searches by. Null unless it came from a requisition.

PayableStageItemResponse.description: One row of a payable-grain stage tab (Entry, Classification, Approval, Reconciled). The grain here is the TITLE, not the installment — these stages act on the payable as a whole.

items.description: The rows on this page. Empty when the page is past the end — that is not an error, and Total still reports the real size of the set.

pageSize.description: How many rows a page holds. It echoes the requested size after clamping, so it can be smaller than what was asked for.

total.description: How many rows the whole filtered set has, across every page.

totalPages.description: How many pages the set spans at this page size.

PayableStageItemResponsePaginatedRespons.description: One page of a list, with the metadata needed to walk the rest.

entry.description: Titles waiting to be completed after entry.

classification.description: Titles waiting for an accounting classification.

accounting.description: Titles waiting for the accounting review.

taxAnalysis.description: Titles in análise tributária — the Tributário must validate the retenções before the title can be paid or posted.

payment.description: Titles scheduled and waiting to be paid — the treasury queue.

fiscalDocumentPending.description: Titles scheduled without a Nota Fiscal. Counted in their own stage too, so this bucket must not be added to the others.

fiscalDocumentPendingAccounting.description: The subset of FiscalDocumentPending still sitting in the accounting stage - the titles the Contabil can attach a Nota Fiscal to right now. Use this for the Pendencias "Nota Fiscal" tab: it is exactly what that tab lists, while the wider bucket also spans tax analysis, payment and reconciled titles whose NF is chased elsewhere.

PayableStageSummaryResponse.description: Pending work across the payable workflow, one bucket per stage — what the tab badges count. FiscalDocumentPending overlaps the others: it is a condition, not a stage of its own.

personType.description: Whether the vendor is a company or an individual.

name.description: Legal name.

taxRegime.description: Tax regime — the main driver of which withholding rules matched.
