valorEfetivado.description: What the bank actually settled, in BRL. A difference from ValorNominal is what makes the entry Divergent.

occurrenceCodes.description: Occurrence codes from the file — the bank's own vocabulary for what happened.

motivo.description: Reason text decoded from the occurrence codes, when one could be decoded.

authCode.description: Authentication code the bank returned for a settled payment.

bankReference.description: The bank's own reference for the entry.

classification.description: What the system concluded: Paid, Rejected, Divergent, Unmatched, Ambiguous or AlreadyProcessed. It decides what confirming this entry would do.

matchMethod.description: How the entry was matched — by our reference, or by a fallback. A weaker match method is a reason to look closer before confirming.

remittanceId.description: Remittance the matched line belongs to. Null when nothing matched.

installmentId.description: Installment behind the matched line — what a confirmation would settle.

note.description: Free-text note explaining a divergence or anything else worth flagging.

RemittanceReturnPreviewEntry.description: One entry of the return file and what the system made of it. The two amounts are the heart of it: what we asked for against what the bank actually settled.

trailerOk.description: Whether the file's batch trailers add up. False means the file is refused outright and no baixa is applied, however good the individual entries look.

trailerMessages.description: What the trailer check found, when it failed.

payer.description: Payer identity read from the file header, so the operator can confirm the file belongs to the account they selected. Null when the header could not be read.

counters.description: How the entries break down across the outcome buckets.

entries.description: The entries themselves, each matched or not to a remittance line.

autoConfirmed.description: How many paid lines were settled automatically. Always 0 on the read-only preview; on the auto-confirm upload it is what the system already booked without asking.

RemittanceReturnPreviewResponse.description: Dry run of a CNAB return file against the pending remittance lines. NOTHING is persisted — the operator reviews what the bank said before confirming the baixas.

remittancesGenerated.description: Remittance files generated. Fewer than the companies processed is normal — a company with nothing eligible produces no file.

RemittanceSweepResult.description: What one run of the automatic remittance sweep produced.

companyId.description: Company whose period is affected. Periods are per company: closing one company's month leaves the others open.

fileName.description: Name of the boleto file to upload. Its extension decides the storage key and the content type of the presigned URL.
Name of the file to be uploaded. Its extension is what decides the storage key and the content type of the presigned URL.

contentType.description: MIME type detected on upload, validated against the file's actual content rather than trusted from the extension.

kind.description: What the file is. FiscalDocument is the one that clears the "NF pendente" flag — a generic attachment does not, even when it happens to be the invoice.

RequisitionAttachmentResponse.description: Metadata of a file attached to a requisition. The bytes are not here — they come from the download endpoint.

controls.description: The budget-control panel per requisition, keyed by requisition id.

RequisitionBudgetControlsResponse.description: Budget-control panels keyed by requisition id. Requisitions that do not exist are omitted.

sequence.description: Position in the recurrence, starting at 1.

competency.description: Competency this cycle covers (`YYYY-MM`) — the month whose budget it consumes.

amount.description: Amount launched for this month, in BRL.

dueDate.description: Due date of this cycle's payable.

paymentMethod.description: How this cycle is to be paid.

boletoDigitableLine.description: Boleto linha digitável for this cycle. Null unless paid by boleto.

pixKeyOverride.description: Per-payment PIX key override (AEL-938) for this cycle. Null unless paid by Pix with an override.

pixPayloadEmv.description: Per-payment PIX "copia e cola" (EMV/BR Code, AEL-963) for this cycle. Null unless paid by a PIX QR.

payableId.description: The Finance payable this cycle generated. Null until Finance confirms it — the two modules talk by event, so there is a window where the cycle exists and the payable does not yet.

realizedAmount.description: Realizado booked to this cycle's competency, in BRL — the sum of non-reversed payments. Compare it against Amount to tell Pago from Parcial and from Aberto.

RequisitionCycleResponse.description: One launched month of a recurring requisition (Conta Fixa). Each cycle generates its own payable, so the recurrence is a series of independent titles rather than one instalment plan.

code.description: Per-company sequential code of the requisition — what people cite.

vendorName.description: Vendor name, denormalized so the row renders without a second call.

description.example: Manutenção preventiva do ar-condicionado do laboratório

estimateValue.description: Value at the time of the decision, in BRL.

status.description: Where the requisition stands NOW, which may be past the decision — it keeps moving after the approver acts.

decisionAction.description: The decision taken: approved, returned for complement, or cancelled.

RequisitionDecisionResponse.description: A decision the current user took, joined with the requisition it was about. Feeds the approver's own history — it is scoped to the caller, not a global decision log.

items.description: The rows on this page. Empty when the page is past the end — that is not an error, and Total still reports the real size of the set.

pageSize.description: How many rows a page holds. It echoes the requested size after clamping, so it can be smaller than what was asked for.

total.description: How many rows the whole filtered set has, across every page.

totalPages.description: How many pages the set spans at this page size.

RequisitionDecisionResponsePaginatedResp.description: One page of a list, with the metadata needed to walk the rest.

sequence.description: Position in the plan, starting at 1.

amount.description: Amount of this installment, in BRL. The sum across installments is what becomes the requisition's programmed total.

paymentMethod.description: How this installment is to be paid. It has to be a method the vendor accepts, and it decides whether a boleto line is expected.

boletoDigitableLine.description: Boleto linha digitável, 47 or 48 digits. Null unless the method is Boleto.

pixKeyOverride.description: Per-payment PIX key override (AEL-938). Null unless the method is Pix with an override — it replaces the vendor's registered PIX key for this payment only.

pixPayloadEmv.description: Per-payment PIX "copia e cola" (EMV/BR Code, AEL-963). Null unless the method is Pix paid by a QR — a static QR decodes to a key, a dynamic QR rides the CNAB forma 47 remittance.

RequisitionInstallmentResponse.description: One installment of the payment plan authored in the financial complement. Together they replace the requester's original estimate with the amount actually programmed.

code.description: Per-company sequential code — what people cite instead of the id.

companyId.description: Company the spend belongs to. Derived from the unit, never sent by the caller.

unitId.description: Unit the spend is charged to.

costCenterId.description: Cost center (natureza) whose monthly budget this consumes.

projectId.description: Project whose accumulated ceiling this also consumes. Optional — the cost center's monthly budget is consumed either way.

type.description: Requisition type. A recurring type (Conta Fixa) is what makes EndCompetency and the cycles meaningful.

description.description: What is being requested — the headline shown throughout the workflow.
description.example: Manutenção preventiva do ar-condicionado do laboratório

observation.description: Extra context for triage and the approver.

estimateValue.description: What the requester estimated, in BRL. Provisional: once the financial complement is submitted, TotalCost is the figure that matters.

estimateType.description: How to read EstimateValue: as the total for the whole window, or as the amount per month.

startCompetency.description: First competency the spend lands in (`YYYY-MM`).

endCompetency.description: Last competency of the window (`YYYY-MM`), inclusive. Null on an open-ended recurrence, which runs until it is explicitly terminated.

paymentFrequency.description: How often the payment repeats over the window.

paymentInstallmentsCount.description: How many installments the payment was expected to be split into. The requester's intent — the authored plan in Installments is what is actually programmed.

firstDueDate.description: Due date of the first installment — it anchors the payable's schedule.

issueDate.description: Emission date of the invoice, informed in the financial complement. Null until that step is submitted.

totalCost.description: Programmed total, in BRL — the sum of the authored installments. Zero before the financial complement is submitted, which is why it can read below EstimateValue on a requisition still in triage.

realizedValue.description: Realizado, in BRL — the sum of non-reversed payments across every competency. This is money that actually left, not what was programmed.

status.description: Where the requisition stands in the workflow.

installments.description: The authored payment plan. Empty before the financial complement is submitted.

cycles.description: Monthly cycles launched after approval on a recurring requisition. Empty on a non-recurring one, and empty before approval.

basePayableId.description: The payable generated on approval. Null until Finance confirms it — the modules talk by event, so approval and the payable are not simultaneous.

baseRealizedAmount.description: Realizado booked to the FIRST competency only, in BRL — not the whole requisition. It exists so the base row of the recurrence panel can show its own status; RealizedValue is the figure that covers everything.

createdAt.description: When the requisition was created as a draft.

statusChangedAt.description: When it entered the current status. This is the clock the stage SLA is measured from, so it moves on every transition.

fiscalDocumentPending.description: Whether the requester still owes a Nota Fiscal. An approximation computed from the requisition's OWN attachments — Budgeting does not read the Finance payable, so an invoice the accountant attaches directly there is not reflected here.

vendorName.description: Vendor name, denormalized for the lists. EMPTY on the single-requisition endpoints, which expect the client to resolve it — do not render it blindly.

RequisitionResponse.description: A requisition — the request that starts the spend workflow. It carries three different money figures on purpose: EstimateValue is what the requester asked for, TotalCost is what the financial complement actually programmed, and RealizedValue is what has been paid.

items.description: The rows on this page. Empty when the page is past the end — that is not an error, and Total still reports the real size of the set.

pageSize.description: How many rows a page holds. It echoes the requested size after clamping, so it can be smaller than what was asked for.

total.description: How many rows the whole filtered set has, across every page.

totalPages.description: How many pages the set spans at this page size.

RequisitionResponsePaginatedResponse.description: One page of a list, with the metadata needed to walk the rest.

oldestOverdueBusinessHours.description: Business hours the oldest overdue requisition has been waiting.

RequisitionSlaLiveResponse.description: What is overdue right now. A live snapshot, unlike the historical sections — it changes as requisitions move, not as the date range changes.

companyId.description: Company the report covers. Null means consolidated.

unitId.description: Unit the report was filtered to. Null means every unit.

from.description: Start of the historical range. Null means from the beginning.

to.description: End of the historical range, inclusive.

generatedAt.description: When the report was computed. It matters because the live section is a snapshot at this instant.

triageThresholdHours.description: Triage threshold used, in business hours.

approvalThresholdHours.description: Approval threshold used, in business hours.

live.description: What is overdue right now, regardless of the date range.

byUnit.description: The same metrics sliced by unit, for the ranking.

RequisitionSlaReportResponse.description: The requisition SLA report: what is overdue right now plus how the stages performed over a range. The live section ignores the date filter — it is always the present.

count.description: How many requisitions are in this stage.

total.description: Sum of the estimated value of those requisitions, in BRL.

RequisitionStageCountResponse.description: Count and summed estimated value of the requisitions in a single workflow stage.

stages.description: Count and summed value per workflow status, keyed by the status name (e.g. Draft, Triage, Approval).

RequisitionStageCountsResponse.description: Requisition counts grouped by workflow status, for the stage KPIs. Statuses with no requisitions are omitted.

action.description: What was done: submitted, triaged, approved, returned, cancelled.

actorName.description: Display name of the actor. Only the single-requisition endpoint resolves it; the list endpoints leave it null rather than pay a directory lookup per row, so read it as "unresolved here" and fall back to the id.

actorPictureUrl.description: The actor's Google profile photo, resolved under the same rule as ActorName. Null for an unresolved actor and for a user with no photo — render initials instead.

reason.description: Justification given. Required on the actions that send the requisition back or cancel it, since that is what the requester reads to know what to fix.
reason.example: Falta a cotação de um segundo fornecedor.

RequisitionTransitionResponse.description: One step of the requisition's history — who moved it, from where to where, and why. The full list is the audit trail of the workflow.

baseAmount.description: Calculation base for this guia, in BRL.

withheldAmount.description: Amount to collect under this guia, in BRL.

RetentionGroupRowResponse.description: One guia de recolhimento's slice. The group, not the individual tax, is what gets paid: CSRF is a single guia covering PIS, COFINS and CSLL together.

reason.description: Why the title is being returned. Shown to the requester on the requisition.

returnTo.description: Which role to return the requisition to: Requester or Controllership. Defaults to Requester.

reason.description: Why the bank did not pay this line. Required — it is what explains the rejection when the installment shows up in the queue again.
What the requester has to fix or supply. Optional, but it is the only guidance they get — it is what the transition history shows them.
reason.example: Attach the vendor's quote and confirm the delivery address.

reason.description: What the requester has to revise in the financial plan (parcelas/emissão). Optional — it is what the transition history shows them.
reason.example: Ajustar a data de vencimento da 2ª parcela.

reason.description: Why the adjustment is being reversed. Optional, but it is what shows up in the transition history the requester reads.
reason.example: Approved against the wrong cost center.

reason.description: Why the entry is being reversed. It becomes the reversal entry's description, so it is what an auditor reads to understand the correction.
reason.example: Estorno — lançamento em centro de custo incorreto

competenceDate.description: Competence date of the REVERSAL entry. Omit to reuse the original's competence; set a later one to book the correction in an open period when the original's is closed.

reason.description: Why the payment is being reversed. Optional, and kept on the reversal.
Why the receipt is being reversed. Optional, and kept on the reversal.

name.description: Role name. It is the key a user references, so renaming one is a breaking change for every user pointing at it.

permissions.description: Permissions the role grants, in `resource:action` form. Admin comes back with an empty list because it bypasses the check rather than holding every permission.

RoleResponse.description: A role and the permissions it carries. Roles are seeded, not created through the API — this endpoint exists to read them and to edit their permission set.

asOf.description: Date to run the sweep for. Omitted uses today.

approvalLimit.description: Highest value this user may approve, in BRL (alçada). Null means unlimited. It is a hard cap with no override: a budget adjustment above it is refused.

hasApprovalAutonomy.description: Autonomy flag. Stored and returned on the user, and carried in the approval authority profile, but no approval flow reads it today — only ApprovalLimit and the budget-adjustment approver grant are enforced. Setting it changes nothing on its own.

canApprove.description: Whether this user may approve and reverse budget adjustments. Read live at approval time, so revoking it takes effect immediately — no sign-in needed.

documentNumber.description: Number of the vendor's fiscal document (número da NF). Send null to clear it.

balance.description: The real balance of the account on AsOf, in BRL, as confirmed against the bank. This becomes the anchor every projection starts from.

reconciledBalance.description: The balance confirmed against the bank, in BRL — the anchor itself.

reconciledAt.description: The date that balance refers to.

currentBalance.description: Balance now, in BRL: the anchor plus everything posted since. It is what the cash-flow projection starts from.

SetReconciledBalanceResponse.description: The account's balance picture after the reconciliation anchor was set.

permissions.description: The role's complete permission set, in `resource:action` form. This REPLACES the current set, so a permission left out is revoked — send the full list, not just the additions. Every value must exist in the catalogue returned by GET /api/permissions; an unknown one returns 400.

active.description: Whether the user may sign in. Deactivating blocks the NEXT sign-in; it does not revoke a token already issued, which stays valid until it expires.

role.description: Role name, which must match one of the seeded roles returned by GET /api/roles. An unknown name returns 400.

companyIds.description: Companies the user may access. Explicit list — an empty one grants nothing rather than everything, and a company left out is revoked.

units.description: Units the user may act in, each paired with its company. That company must also be in CompanyIds, otherwise the whole call is rejected with 400.

costCenters.description: Cost centers the user may act in, each paired with its company. Same rule as Units: the company must be granted too.

items.description: The payable's complete set of withholdings. It REPLACES the current set — an omitted tax is removed, and an empty list clears them all.

reason.description: Why it was left out — unsupported bank, incomplete vendor bank data, already in another remittance.

SkippedInstallmentResponse.description: An installment that was asked for but left out of the file, with the reason. It is not an error — the remittance is generated with what qualifies, and these need fixing separately.

count.description: How many titles are in the stage.

totalAmount.description: Sum of their document totals, in BRL — before withholdings.

netTotalAmount.description: Sum net of withholdings, in BRL. Filled only where the net is already locked and therefore meaningful — today just the payments bucket. Null elsewhere means not applicable, not zero.

StageBucket.description: How much work is sitting in one stage, and what it is worth.

occurrences.description: How many times the stage was traversed in the range. A requisition returned and re-submitted counts more than once.

averageBusinessHours.description: Average business hours spent in the stage.

withinSlaCount.description: How many traversals stayed within the threshold.

withinSlaPercent.description: Percentage of traversals within the threshold.

thresholdHours.description: The threshold this stage was measured against, in business hours.

StageSlaMetricResponse.description: How one stage performed over the reported range — history, not the live queue.

companyId.description: Company the statement belongs to.

bankAccountId.description: Account the statement was imported into.

periodStart.description: First date covered by the file. Null when it could not be determined.

periodEnd.description: Last date covered by the file.

newCount.description: Lines actually added — these are the ones that reach reconciliation.

duplicateCount.description: Lines already present from an earlier import and therefore skipped. A high count on a re-import is expected, not a problem.

status.description: How the import ended.

warning.description: Warning about something odd that did not stop the import — an account id in the file that differs from the selected account, for instance.

StatementImportResponse.description: The result of importing a bank statement. Re-importing an overlapping file is safe: lines already present are counted as duplicates rather than added again.

total.description: Sum of their amounts, in BRL.

StatusBucket.description: How many statement lines sit in one reconciliation status, and what they add up to.

issueDate.description: Single emission date for the whole plan — the accounting competency anchor of the Payable that Finance generates.

installments.description: The authored installment plan. Its sum replaces the requisition's estimated value as the programmed total.

group.description: Guia this tribute is collected under. Several tributes share one guia, which is why the by-group totals are not a simple re-listing of these rows.

baseAmount.description: Calculation base for this tribute, in BRL.

withheldAmount.description: Withheld for this tribute, in BRL.

TaxTypeRowResponse.description: One individual tribute's slice, carrying the guia it is collected under. Finer than the by-group view: it is what shows PIS apart from COFINS inside the same CSRF guia.

endCompetency.description: Last competency the recurrence covers (`YYYY-MM`). Fixing this end date is what lets the requisition finalize.

companyId.description: Company the transaction belongs to.

unitId.description: Unit it is charged to.

costCenterId.description: Cost center it is charged to.

type.description: Direction: money out (Payable) or money in (Receivable). It decides which of VendorId and CustomerId is filled.

vendorId.description: Vendor, on a payable transaction. Null on a receivable one.

customerId.description: Customer, on a receivable transaction. Null on a payable one.

counterpartyName.description: Counterparty name, denormalized so the row renders whichever side it is.

amount.description: Amount, in BRL. Always positive — the direction is in Type.

status.description: Where the transaction stands.

rejectionReason.description: Why it was rejected. Present only on a rejected transaction.

approvedAt.description: When it was approved. Null while pending.

paidAt.description: When it was settled. Null while unpaid.

TransactionResponse.description: A simple transaction — the original single-entry model, superseded by Payable and Receivable for new work. Still in use by the lançamentos screen, so it is not dead, but new integrations should target the richer models instead.

items.description: The rows on this page. Empty when the page is past the end — that is not an error, and Total still reports the real size of the set.

companyId.description: Company the report covers. Null means consolidated across every company the caller may see.

from.description: Start of the competence range. Null means from the beginning of history, which is also when every opening balance is zero.

to.description: End of the competence range, inclusive. Null means up to the latest entry.

costCenterId.description: Cost center the report was filtered to. Null means unfiltered — and note a filtered balancete will not balance, since cost centers only tag part of each entry.

rows.description: One row per account with movement or a balance in the range.

totalDebit.description: Sum of every row's debits, in BRL.

totalCredit.description: Sum of every row's credits, in BRL.

isBalanced.description: Whether total debits equal total credits. False on an unfiltered report means the ledger itself is inconsistent and should be investigated — but it is expected whenever CostCenterId is set.

TrialBalanceResponse.description: The trial balance (balancete). Echoes the filters it was built with, so a stored or shared result still says what it covers.

reducedCode.description: Short code used by the accountants, when the account has one.

accountGroup.description: Which side of the statements the account belongs to.

normalBalance.description: The side that increases this account — it is what gives OpeningBalance and Balance their sign.

openingBalance.description: Saldo anterior: the balance carried in from before the range, in BRL. Zero when the range covers the account's whole history.

totalDebit.description: Debits posted within the range, in BRL. Movement only — it excludes the opening balance.

totalCredit.description: Credits posted within the range, in BRL.

balance.description: Saldo final, in BRL: the opening balance plus the period's movement, signed by the normal balance.

TrialBalanceRowResponse.description: One account's row in the balancete: where it started, what moved in the period, and where it ended. Opening and closing are signed by the account's normal balance, so a positive number means the account is on its expected side.

companyId.description: Company the unit belongs to.

name.description: Unit name as it appears throughout the UI.

acronym.description: Short form used where the full name does not fit — tables, chips, reports.

code.description: Code this unit had in the legacy ERP. Optional, and only meaningful for reconciling against legacy data.

cnpj.description: Establishment CNPJ, digits only. Optional — it exists for accounting tracking and does not have to be filled for the unit to be usable.

isMatriz.description: Whether this is the matriz (head establishment) rather than a filial.

active.description: Whether the unit is in use. An inactive unit is kept for history but cannot be chosen on new documents.

UnitResponse.description: A unit (campus / establishment) of a company. Spend is charged to a unit, and a scoped requester only sees the units granted to them.

UnitScopeAssignment.description: A granted (company, unit) pair. The unit is keyed on its own id, so the same unit cannot appear under two companies.

triageOccurrences.description: Triage traversals in the range for this unit.

triageWithinSlaPercent.description: Percentage of triage traversals within the threshold.

approvalOccurrences.description: Approval traversals in the range for this unit.

approvalWithinSlaPercent.description: Percentage of approval traversals within the threshold.

cycleCount.description: Requisitions that completed a full cycle in this unit.

avgCycleHours.description: Average business hours end to end.

UnitSlaMetricResponse.description: One unit's row of the SLA ranking — the same metrics, sliced by unit.

kind.description: What the file is. Parsed case-insensitively; an unknown value returns 400.

UpdateAttachmentKindRequest.description: New kind for the attachment (Nota Fiscal / Boleto / Fatura / Outro).

bankCode.description: Bank code (codigo de compensacao), three digits.

agency.description: Branch number (agencia), without the check digit.

accountNumber.description: Account number, without the check digit.

accountType.description: Kind of account — checking, savings and so on.

alias.description: Short name shown in the account pickers.

openingBalance.description: Balance the account started with, in BRL. The cash-flow projection anchors on the reconciled balance instead, so this is a starting point, not the live figure.

active.description: Whether the account can still be used. Deactivating keeps its history and its movement.

isDefaultForPayments.description: Use this account when a payable does not name one of its own. Only one per company should carry the flag.

cnabAgreementCode.description: CNAB agreement code (convenio) given by the bank. REQUIRED to generate a payment remittance from this account — without it the account can receive and pay manually but cannot produce a CNAB file.

ledgerAccountId.description: Ledger account that represents this bank account — the credit side when a payable is settled. Required on create; left null on update the settlement falls back to the global cash code.

ofxAccountId.description: OFX account identifier (ACCTID). Used to warn when an imported statement actually belongs to another account. Optional.

agencyDigit.description: Branch check digit. Part of the optional CNAB remittance header profile.

addressStreet.description: Paying company street, for the CNAB remittance header. Optional.

addressNumber.description: Paying company street number, for the CNAB remittance header. Optional.

addressComplement.description: Paying company address complement, for the CNAB remittance header. Optional.

addressCity.description: Paying company city, for the CNAB remittance header. Optional.

addressCep.description: Paying company postal code, for the CNAB remittance header. Optional.

addressState.description: Paying company state (UF), for the CNAB remittance header. Optional.

payerCnpj.description: Override the payer CNPJ used in the CNAB file. Empty falls back to the owning company's CNPJ.

payerLegalName.description: Override the payer legal name used in the CNAB file. Empty falls back to the owning company's legal name.

type.description: What the adjustment does: Supplementation raises the ceiling, Reduction lowers it, Transfer moves budget from SourceCompetency into Competency.

sourceCompetency.description: Source competency (`YYYY-MM`). Required for Transfer, rejected for the other types.

value.description: Amount to move, in BRL. Always positive — the direction comes from Type.

justification.description: Why the adjustment is needed. Required.
justification.example: Reallocation of the unspent training budget to cover equipment maintenance.

counterparts.description: Free-text note on where the offsetting budget comes from (contrapartidas).

requireToApprove.description: Block approval of a payable that has not been classified yet.

requireToPay.description: Block payment of a payable that has not been classified yet.

legalName.description: Legal name (razão social) of the company.

cnpj.description: Company CNPJ. Accepted formatted or bare.

code.description: Accounting code of the cost center. Unique within the company.

name.description: Cost center name (natureza).

autoApprovalLimit.description: Ceiling for automatic approval, in BRL. A payable charged to this cost center whose total is at or below it is approved WITHOUT human review when it gets classified — it does not stop at the approval queue. Zero disables it. unitIds.description: Units allowed to charge this cost center. This REPLACES the current set of links, so omitting a unit unlinks it — send the full list, not just the additions.

name.description: Category name. Must stay unique.

active.description: Whether the category can still be assigned. Deactivating keeps it on the payables that already use it.

competenceDate.description: Accounting competence date — the date that decides which period the entry lands in.

description.example: Provisão de despesas de manutenção — agosto/2026

sourceReference.description: Free-text pointer back to the originating document.

lines.description: The entry's complete set of lines — this REPLACES the existing ones, it does not append. Debits must equal credits.

name.description: Account name as it appears in the chart and in the reports.

reducedCode.description: Short numeric alias (código reduzido). Optional, and unique when supplied.

natureza.description: Natureza classification from the chart, 1 to 5. Optional.

accountGroup.description: Which statement group the account belongs to.

kind.description: Whether the account receives entries or only groups others.

normalBalance.description: Which side is the account's normal balance. Required here, unlike on creation, where it can be derived from the group.

parentId.description: Parent account in the chart hierarchy. Omit for a root account.

isActive.description: Whether the account can still receive new entries. Deactivating keeps it in the chart and keeps its history in the reports — accounts are never deleted.

dreLine.description: Which line of the income-statement cascade this account rolls up into. Only meaningful for result accounts.

vendorId.description: Vendor to be paid. Must reference an existing vendor (vendors are global to the organization).

costCenterId.description: Cost center the expense is charged to.

unitId.description: Unit (estabelecimento) tag for accounting tracking. Ignored on a payable that came from a requisition, which owns its own dimensions.

documentNumber.description: Number of the vendor's document (nota fiscal, fatura or contract).

issueDate.description: Issue date of the document — the accounting competency anchor.

installments.description: The complete installment schedule. It REPLACES the current one, so any installment left out is dropped. Send either this or Generate.

generate.description: Rebuild the schedule from a total, a count and a first due date. The alternative to Installments.

accountingAccountId.description: Expense ledger account for the accounting posting.

paymentBankAccountId.description: Bank account the payment comes out of. Omit to use the company's default.

paymentMethod.description: How this payable is paid. Omit to inherit the paying account's default method.

type.description: Service, product, or null for undetermined. Applied unconditionally — this is a full replace, so sending null genuinely clears the type rather than leaving it as it was.

name.description: Project name. Must stay unique within the company.

description.description: Free-text notes about the project's purpose or scope.

budgetLimit.description: Total budget ceiling for the project, in BRL. Cannot be negative.

initialConsumedValue.description: Value consumed before the project was registered here, in BRL. Cannot be negative.

status.description: Optional lifecycle move. Only Active→Finished and Active→Cancelled are legal; reopening a closed project is rejected. Omit to leave the status untouched.

payerId.description: Customer who owes it. The company is immutable.

costCenterId.description: Cost center the revenue is credited to.

ledgerAccountId.description: Revenue ledger account for the accounting posting. Optional.

documentNumber.description: Number of the document backing the charge.

issueDate.description: Issue date of the document - the accounting competency anchor.

installments.description: The complete installment schedule. It REPLACES the current one, so any installment left out is dropped.

generate.description: Rebuild the schedule from a total, a count and a first due date.

type.description: Requisition type. A recurring type (Conta Fixa) is what makes EndCompetency and the payment frequency meaningful.

description.example: Preventive maintenance of the lab air conditioning

observation.description: Extra context for triage and the approver.

estimateType.description: How to read EstimateValue: as the total for the whole window, or as the amount per month.

startCompetency.description: First competency the spend lands in (`YYYY-MM`). Required.

endCompetency.description: Last competency of the window (`YYYY-MM`), inclusive. Omit for an open-ended recurrence.

paymentFrequency.description: How often the payment repeats over the window.

paymentInstallmentsCount.description: How many installments the payment is split into.

vendorId.description: Vendor to be paid. Required; must reference an existing vendor (vendors are global to the organization).

firstDueDate.description: Due date of the first installment. Required — it anchors the schedule of the Payable that Finance generates on approval.

projectId.description: Project whose accumulated ceiling this requisition consumes. Send null to unlink it.

issueDate.description: Optional emission date informed already at creation (front-load). Send with Installments to keep the plan; omit both to clear a previously front-loaded plan.

installments.description: Optional installment plan (front-load). Present replaces the stored plan; omit both this and IssueDate to clear it and fill the financial part later.

monthlyLimit.description: Ceiling for this single month, in BRL.

active.description: Whether this cell counts toward the budget. Setting it false keeps the row but removes it from the ceiling checks and from the annual total.

name.description: Unit name.

acronym.description: Short form used wherever the full name does not fit.

code.description: Code carried over from the legacy ERP. Optional, and the stable natural key that lets an import match this unit to its legacy counterpart.

cnpj.description: CNPJ of the establishment, for accounting tracking. Optional; when supplied it is check-digit validated and stored unformatted.

isMatriz.description: Whether this unit is the company's headquarters (matriz).

key.description: Storage key of the blob already uploaded through the presigned URL.

fileName.description: Original file name, kept as the document's display name.

contentType.description: MIME type of the uploaded file.

sizeBytes.description: Size of the uploaded file in bytes.

uploadUrl.description: Pre-signed URL to PUT the file to. It carries its own credentials — do not attach the API's Authorization header to it.

key.description: Storage key the file will land under. This is what gets sent back to the API afterwards to attach the upload to a record.

UploadTarget.description: Where to upload a file directly to storage, bypassing the API. The URL is pre-signed and short-lived, so it has to be used promptly.

email.description: Google account the user signs in with.

name.description: Display name from the Google profile.

pictureUrl.description: Profile photo from the Google account, refreshed at every sign-in. Null for a user who has never signed in or whose account has no photo — fall back to initials. The URL is Google's own and rotates when the photo changes, so treat a failed load as "no photo" too.

role.description: Role name. Changing it takes effect on the user's next sign-in, because the permissions travel in the token.

isAdmin.description: Whether the user is an Admin, and so bypasses every permission and scope check. The scope collections below are empty for one.

active.description: Whether the user may sign in. Deactivating blocks the next sign-in and leaves an already-issued token valid until it expires.

pendingFirstLogin.description: Whether the user was pre-registered and has never signed in. The role and scope below are what their first Google login will carry.

canApproveBudgetAdjustment.description: Whether the user may approve budget adjustments. Read live, so it applies immediately rather than on next sign-in.

companyIds.description: Companies granted to the user. Explicit list: empty means no access, not full access — except for an Admin, who bypasses scope entirely.

units.description: Units granted, each paired with its company. Only the scoped roles (Requester, Approver) are constrained by it; for the others it is stored and ignored.

costCenters.description: Cost centers granted, each paired with its company. Same rule as Units.

UserAdminResponse.description: A user as the access-admin screen sees them: identity, role, whether they can sign in, and the full scope they act within.

name.description: Display name.

email.description: Google account the user signs in with.

approvalLimit.description: Highest value this user may approve, in BRL. Null means unlimited. It is a hard cap with no override.

hasApprovalAutonomy.description: Autonomy flag. Stored and echoed here, but no approval flow reads it today — only ApprovalLimit and the budget-adjustment approver grant are enforced. Do not gate anything on it.

UserApprovalAuthorityResponse.description: A user's approval authority (alçada) after an update.

email.description: Google account the user signed in with. It is the identity key: the account is matched by e-mail, so changing it in Google creates a different user here.

name.description: Display name, taken from the Google profile.

role.description: Role name. It carries the permissions, but the effective list is on /auth/me — do not gate the UI on the name.

UserSummary.description: Who just signed in — the minimum the client needs to render the header before it calls /auth/me for the full profile.

personType.description: Legal nature of the counterparty. It decides whether Document is read as a CNPJ or a CPF.

name.description: Legal name (razão social). Required.

tradeName.description: Trading name (nome fantasia), when it differs from the legal name.

document.description: CNPJ or CPF, matching PersonType. Accepted formatted or bare; stored normalized (alphanumeric CNPJ, digits CPF) and validated with the check digits.

paymentTerms.description: Agreed payment terms, free text — shown to whoever schedules the payment.

bankInfo.description: Bank details used to pay this vendor.

taxRegime.description: Tax regime. Drives which withholdings apply to the vendor's invoices.

paymentScheduleMode.description: When to settle: on the due date, or on a fixed day of the month set by PaymentScheduleDay.

paymentScheduleDay.description: Day of the month to pay on. Only meaningful when PaymentScheduleMode pins payments to a fixed day.

cprbForeseen.description: Whether CPRB is expected for this vendor, for INSS purposes. The registry only suggests it — the fiscal document confirms. Null means unknown.

simplesAnexo.description: Simples Nacional annex, for INSS purposes. Suggestion only, same as CprbForeseen.

acceptedPaymentMethods.description: Payment methods this vendor accepts. Omitted or empty means no restriction.

withholdingRates.description: Per-tax withholding rate overrides. Only the rate is overridden — whether a tax applies at all still comes from the regime. Omitted or empty uses the system defaults.

associatedLedgerAccountIds.description: Default expense ledger accounts suggested when classifying this vendor's payables. Omitted or empty means none.

primaryCnaeCode.description: Primary CNAE code, normally filled from the CNPJ lookup.

personType.description: Whether the vendor is a company (CNPJ) or an individual (CPF). It decides how Document is validated and which withholdings can apply.

name.description: Legal name (razão social for a company, full name for an individual).

tradeName.description: Trade name (nome fantasia), when it differs from the legal name.

document.description: CNPJ or CPF, digits only — which one follows PersonType.

phone.description: Contact phone, digits only, with area code.

address.description: Postal address. Comes back with empty fields rather than null when the vendor was registered without one.

paymentTerms.description: Agreed payment terms, as free text. Descriptive only — nothing computes a due date from it.

bankInfo.description: Bank and Pix data. Incomplete data is what makes a CNAB remittance refuse this vendor.

taxRegime.description: Tax regime. It drives the withholding rules that apply — a Simples vendor is treated differently from a Lucro Presumido one.

paymentScheduleMode.description: How this vendor's due dates are set: on the invoice's own terms, or pinned to a fixed day of the month.

paymentScheduleDay.description: Day of month the payment is pinned to. Only meaningful when PaymentScheduleMode pins to a fixed day; null otherwise.

active.description: Whether the vendor is in use. An inactive vendor is kept for history but cannot be chosen on a new requisition or payable.

cprbForeseen.description: Whether the vendor is expected to fall under CPRB (desoneração da folha), which suppresses the INSS withholding. Null means it was never determined — not that it is false, so do not treat the two the same.

simplesAnexo.description: Simples Nacional annex the vendor falls in. Only meaningful when TaxRegime is Simples; it selects the withholding table.

acceptedPaymentMethods.description: Payment methods this vendor accepts. It constrains what an installment may be paid by, and a remittance only covers the methods the bank layout supports.

withholdingRates.description: Per-tax rates registered for this vendor. They override the default rule for the regime, which is how an exception negotiated with one vendor is expressed.

associatedLedgerAccountIds.description: Ledger accounts usually posted against for this vendor. A convenience for the accounting review, which pre-selects them — not a restriction.

primaryCnaeCode.description: Primary CNAE code, as returned by the CNPJ lookup. It is what suggests the service nature and the withholding profile.

primaryCnaeDescription.description: Human-readable description of the primary CNAE.

createdAt.description: When the vendor was registered. The triage screen uses it to flag a vendor as new, so an approver knows the counterparty has no history yet.

VendorResponse.description: A vendor (fornecedor) — who gets paid. Beyond identity and bank data it carries the tax profile that decides which withholdings a payable calculates, so an incomplete vendor produces wrong net amounts rather than an error.

items.description: The rows on this page. Empty when the page is past the end — that is not an error, and Total still reports the real size of the set.

pageSize.description: How many rows a page holds. It echoes the requested size after clamping, so it can be smaller than what was asked for.

total.description: How many rows the whole filtered set has, across every page.

totalPages.description: How many pages the set spans at this page size.

VendorResponsePaginatedResponse.description: One page of a list, with the metadata needed to walk the rest.

companyId.description: Company the assessment was filtered to. Null means it spans every company the caller may see, which is the consolidated view.

byCompany.description: Fiscal breakdown by collecting establishment. This is the axis the XML export is built from.

byRetentionGroup.description: Fiscal breakdown by guia de recolhimento — what actually gets paid.

byTaxType.description: Breakdown by individual tribute, finer than the guia view.

byCostCenter.description: Management breakdown by cost center. Internal only — never exported.

facts.description: Every withholding line behind the totals, for the drill-down drawer.

WithholdingAssessmentResponse.description: The withholding assessment (apuração) for one competência, sliced every way the screen needs. The same money is counted in every breakdown — they are views of one set of facts, not amounts to be added together.

baseAmount.description: Sum of the calculation bases, in BRL.

amount.description: Planned withholding for this tax, in BRL — Realized plus Foreseen.

realizedAmount.description: Already withheld for this tax, in BRL.

foreseenAmount.description: Still to be withheld for this tax, in BRL.

WithholdingByTaxRow.description: One tax's slice of the report, with its realized/foreseen split.

counterpartyName.description: Counterparty name as recorded on the payable, denormalized for the drawer.

documentNumber.description: Invoice number of the payable, when one was registered.

vendorDocument.description: Vendor CNPJ or CPF, digits only — the counterparty the tax is withheld from.

group.description: Guia the tribute is collected under.

baseAmount.description: Calculation base of this line, in BRL.

amount.description: Amount withheld on this line, in BRL.

WithholdingFactResponse.description: A single withholding line — one tribute on one payable. Every breakdown above is an aggregation of these, so this is where a total that looks wrong gets explained.

counterpartyName.description: Vendor name as recorded on the payable.

status.description: Where the payable stands — it is what explains how much of the withholding is still only foreseen.

totalWithheld.description: Planned withholding on this payable, in BRL.

netTotal.description: What the vendor receives, in BRL.

lines.description: The per-tax lines behind this payable's withholding.

realizedAmount.description: Already withheld on this payable, in BRL.

foreseenAmount.description: Still to be withheld on this payable, in BRL.

WithholdingPayableRow.description: One payable that carries withholdings, with its per-tax lines.

retains.description: Whether the system rules would withhold it for this profile.

reason.description: Why it would not be withheld. Only meaningful when Retains is false.

rateSource.description: Where the rate would come from.

rate.description: The rate that would apply, as a percentage. Null when nothing is withheld or when the rate depends on the invoice — see InvoiceDependent.

invoiceDependent.description: Whether the rate can only be known from the invoice. True for ISS, where the municipality sets it — so a null Rate here means undeterminable, not zero.

WithholdingPreviewItem.description: What the system rules would do for one tax, given a vendor's tax profile. A preview: it shows the default BEFORE any vendor-specific rate override is applied, so the registration screen can show what changes if the override is removed.

baseAmount.description: Amount the rate applies to, in BRL.

rate.description: Rate applied, as a percentage. Null when the amount came from a fixed value.

amount.description: Planned withholding for this line, in BRL.

timing.description: When the tax is recognized: at the document (OnIssue) or at each payment (OnPayment). OnIssue lines are realized immediately; OnPayment lines stay foreseen until the installment is paid.

realizedAmount.description: Already withheld on this line, in BRL.

foreseenAmount.description: Still to be withheld on this line, in BRL.

WithholdingReportLine.description: One withholding line of a payable, carrying WHEN the tax is recognized — which is what decides whether its amount counts as realized or foreseen.

companyId.description: Company the rule applies to. Null makes it a system-wide rule — a company-specific rule wins over the system default for the same tax profile.

lc116Subitem.description: LC 116 service subitem the rule matches, stored canonically. Null matches any subitem.

vendorRegime.description: Vendor tax regime the rule matches. Null matches any regime.

municipalityIbge.description: IBGE code of the municipality the rule matches — relevant for ISS, where the rate is set locally. Null matches any municipality.

retains.description: Whether a match withholds the tax. False makes this an explicit non-retention rule, and Reason then records why.

reason.description: Why the tax is NOT withheld. Only meaningful when Retains is false.

rateSource.description: Where the rate comes from: a fixed value set here, or resolved from the invoice.

rate.description: Withholding rate as a percentage. Required and positive when the rule retains with a fixed rate — otherwise the call is rejected with 400.

baseRule.description: Which amount the rate is applied to.

minimumAmount.description: Floor below which nothing is withheld, in BRL. Null means no floor.

cprb.description: Match only vendors whose CPRB status is this. Null matches regardless.

simplesAnexo.description: Match only vendors on this Simples Nacional annex. Null matches regardless.

companyId.description: Company the rule applies to. Null makes it a system-wide rule, and a company-specific rule wins over the system default for the same profile.

lc116Subitem.description: LC 116 service subitem the rule matches, stored canonically. Null is a wildcard — it matches any subitem.

vendorRegime.description: Vendor tax regime the rule matches. Null matches any regime.

municipalityIbge.description: IBGE code of the municipality the rule matches — relevant for ISS, whose rate is set locally. Null matches any municipality.

retains.description: Whether a match withholds the tax. False makes this an explicit NON-retention rule, which is not the same as having no rule: it records that the exemption was decided, and Reason says why.

reason.description: Why the tax is not withheld. Only meaningful when Retains is false.

rateSource.description: Where the rate comes from: a fixed value stored here, or resolved from the invoice. ISS is invoice-dependent, so its rate cannot be known at registration time.

rate.description: Withholding rate as a percentage. Present when the rule retains at a fixed rate; null when the rate comes from the invoice or nothing is withheld.

baseRule.description: Which amount the rate applies to — gross, net, or the service portion.

minimumAmount.description: Floor below which nothing is withheld, in BRL. Null means no floor.

cprb.description: Match only vendors with this CPRB status. Null matches regardless — which is different from matching vendors whose status was never determined.

simplesAnexo.description: Match only vendors on this Simples Nacional annex. Null matches regardless.

active.description: Whether the rule is in force. An inactive rule is kept for audit but takes no part in matching, so deactivating one changes what new payables withhold.

WithholdingRuleResponse.description: One row of the withholding decision table. A payable is matched against these to decide whether a tax is withheld and at what rate; the null fields are wildcards, so a rule with fewer constraints matches more payables.

byTax.description: Breakdown per individual tax. PIS, COFINS and CSLL are grouped into CSRF by the client for display — the server keeps them apart.

byPayable.description: The payables behind the totals, each with its own lines.

WithholdingsReportResponse.description: The withholding report. Every amount splits into what is already retido (Realized) and what is still previsto (Foreseen), because the two are recognized at different moments: IRRF, INSS and ISS at the document, the CSRF group only at each payment. Planned always equals Realized plus Foreseen.

grossTotal.description: Sum of the document totals, in BRL — before withholdings.

withheldTotal.description: Planned withholding, in BRL. Equals RealizedTotal plus ForeseenTotal.

netTotal.description: What the vendors receive, in BRL: gross minus withheld.

realizedTotal.description: Already withheld, in BRL — recognized at the document (IRRF, INSS, ISS) or at a payment that has happened.

foreseenTotal.description: Still to be withheld, in BRL — chiefly the CSRF group on installments not yet paid.

WithholdingsTotals.description: Headline totals across the payables that carry withholdings.

companyId.description: Company whose exercise is being closed.

fiscalYear.description: The fiscal year that was closed.

alreadyClosed.description: Whether the year was already closed before this call. True means nothing was posted now and the figures below describe the earlier close.

netIncome.description: Result carried to retained earnings, in BRL — positive for profit.

resultAccountsCleared.description: How many result accounts were zeroed out. Revenue and expense accounts start the next year at zero; balance-sheet accounts carry their balances over.

YearEndClosingResponse.description: Outcome of a year-end close (apuração do resultado). The operation is idempotent — running it twice does not post the result twice, it reports that the year was already closed.
